specialRules.name: Endless Legions
specialRules.text: Each time a Rule, Special Rule, or Reaction calls for any number of Resurrection Tests to be made for a Unit that has this Special Rule, the number of Resurrection Tests made as part of that Rule, Special Rule or Reaction is modified by +1.

specialRules.name: Fabricator Claw Array
specialRules.text: The values in brackets associated with any variants of the Battlesmith (X) and Fabricator (X) Special Rules of any model equipped with a Fabricator Claw Array are doubled.

specialRules.name: Fabricator (X)
specialRules.text: In the Controlling Player's Movement Phase as the Active Player, when a model with the Fabricator (X) Special Rule has been selected, but before or after it has been moved, the Controlling Player can Activate this Special Rule. Once Activated, the controlling player of the Model with the Fabricator (X) special rule (referred to as the 'Acting Model') selects one friendly Unit with the Reanimant Trait within 6" of the Acting Model. Once a Target Unit has been selected, the Controlling Player makes a number of Resurrection (4+) Tests for the Target Unit equal to the value in brackets associated with the variant of the Fabricator (X) Special Rule of the Acting Model. If a model with the Fabricator (X) Special Rule also has the Battlesmith (X) Special Rule, the model's Battlesmith (X) Special Rule may not be Activated in the same Phase as its Fabricator (X) Special Rule.

specialRules.name: Canoptek Hive
specialRules.text: In the Controlling Player's Movement Phase as the Active Player, when a model with the Canoptek Hive has been selected, but before or after it has been moved, the controlling player may Target one friendly unit of Canoptek Scarabs within 6" of the model with the Canoptek Hive Special Rule (referred to as the 'Acting Model'). Add one Scarab Swarm Model to the Target Unit so that it is in coherency with the Target Unit and wholly within 6" of the Acting Model, then take an Intelligence Check for the Acting Model. If successful, nothing happens. If failed, 1 Damage is inflicted to the Acting Model. No Saving Throw or Damage Mitigation Roll may be taken against that Damage.

specialRules.name: Access Points
specialRules.text: The entire Left and Side Arcs of the Ghost Ark are counted as an Access Point.

specialRules.name: Repair Barge
specialRules.text: Only Necron Warriors may Embark upon a Ghost Ark. No other model of any kind may Embark upon a Ghost Ark. In the controlling player's Movement Phase as the Active Player, when a Model with the Repair Barge Special Rule has been selected, but either before or after it has been moved, the controlling player of that model may activate this Special Rule. Once activated, the controlling player of the model must select one unit of Necron Warriors that is either within 6" of the model or Embarked upon it and makes 3 Resurrection (4+) Tests for that unit.

specialRules.name: Translocation Portal
specialRules.text: A model equipped with a Translocation Portal can be assigned the following Combat Assignment: Invasion Mission. -- Once assigned an Invasion Mission in the Reserves Sub-Phase, a model must be immediately placed onto the Battlefield by the Controlling player. The Model may be placed anywhere along the Battlefield Edge that is within the Controlling Player's Deployment Zone. This deployment can trigger the Intercept Advanced Reaction, but any attacks made at the Model are made as Snap Shots. -- In the Movement Phase, a model with an Invasion Mission can be selected and must then move up to a number of inches equal to its Movement Characteristic straight forwards without turning. At this point a Combat Air Patrol can be declared by the Reactive Player. Once any Combat Air Patrol Reactions have been resolved, the Controlling Player may select a Unit entirely composed of models with the Infantry Type in reserves that has no more than 15 models (counting models with the Bulky (X) special rule as a number of models equal to the value of X attached to that special rule) that is in reserves or on the battlefield wholly within 12" of the Model with the Invasion Mission and apply the following depending on that unit's location: --- In Reserves: Place the unit anywhere on the battlefield wholly within 12" of the base of the Model with the Invasion Mission. A unit placed on the battlefield this way cannot triger Reactions and cannot move further in the current Movement Phase but is counted as having moved for the purpose of any rules and special rules. --- On the Battlefield: Remove the unit from the Battlefield and place it in Reserves. -- In the Shooting Phase, a model that has been assigned an Invasion Mission may make Shooting Attacks, but must make all attacks as Snap Shots. At the end of the Controlling Player's Shooting Phase, the Model assigned an Invasion Mission is removed from play and returned to Aerial Reserves.

specialRules.name: Chain Destruction
specialRules.text: For each Unsaved Wound caused with a Ranged Weapon by a Model with this Special Rule, the Controlling Player may make another Attack for that model using the same Weapon as part of the same Fire Group, before moving on to the next Fire Group. Additional Attacks granted by the Chain Destruction Special Rule do not themselves generate more Attacks.
